about: Loadsmart is a Chicago freight technology company with an AI-driven platform that matches shippers with carriers for truckload, intermodal and drayage freight, and offers a transportation management system. Customers are enterprise shippers, brokers and carriers, earning from freight margins and software fees. Founded in 2014, it raised about 346 million dollars, with backers including Maersk and Tiger Global. Private. B2B logistics brand with little consumer awareness.

At-Bay is a San Francisco insurtech that provides cyber insurance and technology errors and omissions coverage for businesses, using security scanning data and risk tools to underwrite and help clients improve defenses. Customers are small to mid-size businesses sold via brokers. Founded in 2016, it raised about 296 million dollars with a 1.35 billion dollar valuation in 2021. Private. B2B insurance brand with limited consumer awareness.

Macnica Galaxy is a Taiwanese AI technology subsidiary of Japan's Macnica Holdings, based in Taipei, working on AI hardware and software solutions and distribution for edge devices, industrial customers and technology firms. It has raised around 761 million new Taiwan dollars. It is listed on Taiwan's stock market. B2B technology brand with no consumer awareness. Specific products are not confirmed here. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

wiki.title: Presidio
wiki.text: A presidio was a fortified base established by the Spanish Empire mainly between the 16th and 18th centuries in areas under their control or influence. The term is derived from the Latin word praesidium meaning protection or defense.

about: Unqork is a US no-code enterprise application platform, based in New York, founded in 2017 by Gary Hoberman. It lets banks, insurers and governments build complex software with visual tools rather than hand-written code. Customers include large financial firms and public agencies, paying subscriptions. It raised about $365 million, with a valuation of $2 billion in 2021. Privately held. B2B software, no consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Unqork
wiki.text: Unqork is a cloud computing and enterprise software company based in New York, NY that offers a no-code development platform-as-a-service (PaaS) for building enterprise applications. Unqork supports organizations in finance, insurance, healthcare, and government.

about: Beyond Identity is a US cybersecurity company, based in New York, founded in 2019 by Jim Clark and Tom Jermoluk, selling passwordless, phishing-resistant authentication and device trust based on cryptographic keys rather than passwords. Customers are enterprises and technology companies. It raised about $205 million, including a $100 million Series C in 2022. Privately held. B2B security brand, with no consumer awareness.

Virtana is a Palo Alto-based software company whose hybrid cloud optimisation platform gives enterprises observability, capacity planning and cost optimisation across on-premises infrastructure and public clouds, with AI-driven analytics. It was formerly known for infrastructure performance monitoring under the earlier Virtual Instruments name. Customers are large enterprises and service providers, paying software subscriptions. Crunchbase shows about $195 million raised. Privately held. B2B, with little brand awareness beyond enterprise IT.

It sells subscriptions to mid-sized and large companies. Founded in 2015, it has raised about $161 million, with a Series C in 2022. Privately held. Strictly B2B, with recognition in legal technology but no consumer awareness.

about: Panzura is a data management company whose products give enterprises a global file system and hybrid cloud storage, enabling teams across multiple locations to access, protect and analyse unstructured data such as engineering and media files. Customers are large organisations in sectors like construction, engineering, media and government, paying software and subscription fees. Based in San Francisco, it has raised about $170 million. Privately held. B2B enterprise infrastructure, with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Panzura
wiki.text: Panzura is a privately owned American software company based in San Francisco, California, that provides hybrid-cloud data management software and services for the enterprise software market. Its software helps users access, manage, analyze, and store unstructured data using techniques in distributed data consolidation, artificial intelligence, and network load balancing.

about: Alt is a Tokyo-based Japanese artificial intelligence company, with an office in Roppongi, that develops large language models and AI products for businesses, such as the AI GIJIROKU meeting transcription service, and works on generative AI and cultural projects. Customers are Japanese companies and public bodies, and revenue is from software subscriptions and AI development. It listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in 2023. Crunchbase shows about 5.4 billion yen in funding. B2B, with some recognition in Japan's AI sector.

It employs several thousand people and has been backed by private equity (Bencis and, later, others). B2B IT firm with limited public brand awareness.

about: Zetrix is a Malaysian blockchain and digital infrastructure company based in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, that builds the Zetrix public blockchain, digital identity and tokenisation solutions for government and enterprises. It is linked to MYEG Services, the e-government services provider, and has been publicised for the Zetrix AI chain and Zetrix wallet in Malaysia and Asia. Crunchbase shows about $40 million raised, latest February 2026, and flags the company as listed. Mostly B2B and government projects, moderate awareness in Malaysia.

wiki.title: List of Tetris variants
wiki.text: This is a list of variants of the game Tetris. It also includes officially licensed Tetris sequels, as well as unofficial clones. In 2017 Guinness World Records reported Tetris to be the game with most official versions released, at 220, over 65 different platforms.

about: Eclairion is a French data computing centre in Bruyeres-le-Chatel, in the Essonne area south of Paris, offering high-performance computing and AI infrastructure hosting for public research bodies, industry and technology clients. It earns from hosting, capacity and service contracts. Crunchbase shows about 160 million in funding, with the latest round in February 2025, suggesting investment in capacity expansion. Privately held. B2B infrastructure with little brand awareness outside the HPC and data centre sector.

about: Pivot3 was a hyperconverged infrastructure company that supplied integrated storage and computing systems, especially for video surveillance, to enterprises and governments. It was based in Austin, Texas, with Colorado listed in the input, and its assets were acquired by Quantum Corporation in 2021. It was a B2B technology brand known to IT and security integrators, with no consumer visibility. It is no longer an independent company.

India's largest staffing and business services company, based in Bangalore and founded by Ajit Isaac, with operations in general staffing, IT staffing, facility management, security services and logistics. Customers are thousands of enterprises across sectors, and it places or manages several hundred thousand workers. Brands within the group include Quess IT Staffing, Conneqt, Allsec and Terrier Security Services. It is listed on the NSE and BSE, and Fairfax-linked Thomas Cook India originally founded and controlled it. Largely B2B with limited consumer recognition, though the name is known in Indian HR circles.

Victory Capital is a US asset management firm headquartered in San Antonio, Texas, listed on Nasdaq (VCTR), that owns multiple independent investment franchises and manages around 300 billion dollars in mutual funds, ETFs and separate accounts. It sells through financial advisers and institutions and has grown by acquiring firms such as USAA Asset Management and Amundi US. Founded as a KeyCorp unit and independent since 2013. B2B financial brand with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Victory Capital
wiki.text: Victory Capital Holdings, Inc. is an American financial services company headquartered in San Antonio, Texas that focuses on investment management. Outside the US, it also has investment professionals in London, Hong Kong and Singapore.

wiki.title: Propel (company)
wiki.text: Propel, Inc. is an American fintech software company that builds services for low income families. It is best known for Providers, a mobile app that allows users to track their Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) balances and other government benefits. Approximately one quarter of American households receiving SNAP benefits are enrolled in the app.

about: Patria Investments is a Cayman Islands-registered alternative asset manager focused on Latin America, with operations in Sao Paulo, offering private equity, infrastructure, real estate, credit and public equities funds to institutional and wealthy investors. It manages more than 40 billion dollars and was formed in 1994, with Blackstone and later Itau as investors. It is listed on Nasdaq (PAX) since 2021. Financial brand known to investors, with no consumer profile.

Inseego is a San Diego company making wireless products for the 5G and 4G market, such as mobile hotspots, MiFi devices, fixed wireless access routers and indoor and outdoor 5G equipment, plus cloud management services for businesses and carriers. Customers are mobile operators such as Verizon and T-Mobile, enterprises, and consumers via carrier channels. Revenue is from hardware sales and subscriptions. Listed on Nasdaq (INSG). Brand recognition mainly with carriers and business buyers, and moderate among mobile hotspot users.
